title: @awacloud/graphic-anim — demos
description: One runnable page per graphic.anim capability — clock, engine, frames, hypertree, lumen-rail, neon-boot, pageflip, scene, svg3d, towards-anm.

demos.title: Clock
demos.summary: Analog clock — legacy clock.js reproduction (scene + tween + scheduler).

demos.title: Engine
demos.summary: Tween + timeline + stagger on real <svg> shapes.

demos.title: Lumen Rail
demos.summary: A one-minute rail shooter: pooled sprites (no DOM node per frame), the svg3d kernels for the perspective, keys or drag to steer, an autopilot.

demos.title: Neon Grid
demos.summary: An 11 s, five-act boot sequence on one timeline, then a pure function of time: scrub it, slow it down, read the code of each act.

demos.title: Pageflip
demos.summary: Six-page book, page-curl fold, rapid-turn guard.

demos.title: Scene
demos.summary: JSON to SVG scene/event DSL, a traffic light.

demos.title: Svg3d
demos.summary: Software-3D heightmap terrain in SVG, orbiting camera.

demos.title: Towards anm
demos.summary: Acceptance demo — legacy TOWARDS-ANM choreography, modern engine only.
